signin.title: Sign in
signin.subtitle: Welcome back. Enter your credentials to continue.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.successCopy: If that email is registered, we've sent a password-reset link. Check your inbox (and your spam folder).

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Set the password you'll use to sign in.
resetPassword.success: Password reset. Redirecting you to sign in…

errors.breached: This password appears in known breach lists — choose a different one.
errors.same: New password must differ from the current one.
errors.weak: Password doesn't meet the strength requirements.
errors.invalidToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.missingToken: This page expects a reset token in the URL. Use the link from your email.

changeEmail.title: Change email
changeEmail.subtitle: Confirm your new email by clicking the link we send.
changeEmail.successCopy: Check your new inbox for a confirmation link. The change isn't applied until you click it.

errors.inUse: That email is already in use on another account.

confirm.title: Confirm your new email
confirm.subtitle: We're verifying the token in your link…
confirm.success: Email updated. Use the new one to sign in.
confirm.missingToken: This page expects a confirmation token in the URL. Use the link from your email.
confirm.invalidToken: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.

errors.accountLocked: Account locked after too many failed attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.mustChangePassword: Set a new password to continue.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

mustChange.title: Set a new password
mustChange.subtitle: Your account needs a fresh password before you can continue. Pick one you don't use elsewhere.

security.title: Account & Security
security.subtitle: Manage your sign-in credentials. Changes take effect immediately and may sign you out of other devices.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Pick a strong password you don't use elsewhere. We'll keep you signed in on this device.
changePassword.newPasswordHint: At least 12 characters. Must differ from your current password.

errors.incorrectCurrent: That doesn't match your current password.
errors.generic: Couldn't update your password. Please try again.
